extracted.name: Upside-Down Pumpkin Cake
extracted.description: This pumpkin upside-down cake has become my family's favorite dessert at Thanksgiving, taking the place of pumpkin pie! Walnuts can be substituted for pecans.
ingredient_lines: 1 (18.25 ounce) package yellow cake mix with pudding
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

In a mixing bowl, blend pumpkin, cinnamon, cloves, salt, sugar, eggs, and milk. Pour mixture into a 9x13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle dry cake mix and nuts over the batter. Pour melted butter over the cake.
Bake in the preheated oven for 60 minutes, then let cool. The cake will be liquidy at first, but will solidify as it cools.
